title: Zimnitsky urine test (24-hour, in portions)
what: For 24 hours, you collect urine into 8 separate jars, one every 3 hours. This test is common in Russia and nearby countries. The lab checks how your kidneys concentrate urine by day and by night.
why: To check how your kidneys work, if you pee often at night, or for swelling or thirst.
duration: collection takes 24 hours; results usually come in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: If you take water pills. Your doctor will tell you what to do on the collection day
If you have your period now

prepare.title: Jars
prepare.text: You need 8 clean containers. Label each with a time: 9:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00, 21:00, 0:00, 3:00, 6:00, or as the lab tells you.

prepare.title: Food and drink
prepare.text: Eat and drink as usual. Write down how much you drank in 24 hours, if your doctor asked.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor about water pills in advance. They will decide.

prepare.title: Alarm
prepare.text: Set an alarm for the night portions.

steps: In the morning at about 6:00, pee into the toilet. You do not keep this urine
After that, every 3 hours, pee into the jar with the right time
If you need to pee again within those 3 hours, use the same jar
If a jar fills up, take an extra one and label it with the same time
Collect the last portion at 6:00 the next morning
Keep the jars in the fridge and take them to the lab in the morning
feel: Nothing unpleasant, but you need to watch the time, including at night
after: Results usually come in 1 to 2 days
Your doctor will explain the results

faq.q: What if I did not need to pee during one time slot?
faq.a: Leave that jar empty and still bring it to the lab.
No. Drink as usual. Otherwise the result will not be accurate.

reminders.text: Your Zimnitsky urine collection starts tomorrow. Get 8 labeled jars ready and set an alarm for the night.
